title: Phase-conditioned folded-influence route to uniform local measured Renyi control
status: PROPOSED BREAKTHROUGH ROUTE; NO PROOF GATE CLOSED
question: Can the actual real-time Q3 split-history local coordinate likelihood be controlled uniformly by conditioning before estimating, folding the forward/backward history into a positive two-replica Euclidean collar, and proving phase-conditioned shell influence summability?

contrast_with_prior_routes: Do not bound the global quantum Renyi divergence; the disjoint-product counterexample makes that target volume-extensive.
Do not bound a raw total energy or raw configuration multiplier norm; the registered cutoff and point-norm obstructions already reject those carriers.
Do not reuse the EXP-000769 spatial spectral martingale as if it were an actual split-history theorem; it controls a comparator interaction, not the onsite-interspersed Q3 history likelihood.
First pass to the fixed local coordinate measurement, then expose only the spacetime collar capable of influencing that measurement.
new_perspective.why_exp_001202_matters: The finite actual-Q3 table keeps local Q2 close to one while global targets and fixed spectral windows fail. This is consistent with a genuinely local cancellation mechanism, but is not evidence of uniformity by itself.

algebraic_starting_point.local_measured_q2: For reference p and history output q on one local coordinate measurement, Q2(q||p)=sum_x q(x)^2/p(x)=1+||ell-1||^2_{L2(p)}, where ell=dq/dp.
algebraic_starting_point.localization_identity: If a positive global comparison density L exists, the local likelihood is ell=E_reference[L | local coordinate sigma-field]. The proof must construct or dominate the relevant L for the actual folded split history; it may not assume this positivity.
algebraic_starting_point.phase_mixture_convexity: For common phase weights w_s, p=sum_s w_s p_s and q=sum_s w_s q_s imply Q2(q||p)<=sum_s w_s Q2(q_s||p_s). If the history changes phase weights, an explicit finite phase-label Q2 factor is additionally required.
algebraic_starting_point.pure_bond_input: Use the already accepted exact invariance of local coordinate tails under pure bond layers. Only onsite-interspersed increments enter the new influence estimate.

ownership_and_controls.independence_requirement: A load-bearing analytic inequality must receive a non-importing derivation or exact counterfixture and Lean cross-check for its finite algebraic skeleton before result promotion.
ownership_and_controls.literature_requirement: Before importing a Dobrushin, contour, replica or modular theorem, audit its exact model, dimension, boundary condition, phase, norm, beta range, regulator and uniformity hypotheses against Q3LOCK. No theorem name is evidence by itself.

promotion_criteria: Prove FI-2 without a sign, normalization or replica constant growing with volume or prefix length.
Prove FI-3 in the actual registered phase/beta regime for all allowed spatial shapes, with explicit cutoff- and source-independent constants.
Cover every prefix, both split orders, both time signs and adjoints, rather than the zero/first/full sample of EXP-001202.
Remove the coordinate cutoff on one stated common local core and prove direct exhaustion Cauchy estimates.
Run adversarial sign, convention, phase-weight, boundary, cutoff and all-shape tests and register any fired obstruction before common-alpha promotion.
stop_conditions: If phase-conditioned two-site or fixed-collar local Q2 diverges with cutoff, retire the uniform FI route and register the scoped obstruction.
If every positive folded domination pays an exponential volume or history-length sign cost, stop FI-2 and move to the modular-cocycle fallback; do not hide the cost in a diagnostic constant.

If the within-phase influence norm is not contractive in the target beta regime and no verified contour/polymer replacement applies, restrict the theorem to the valid regime rather than promote the full gate.
If phase weights are not preserved, retain the explicit phase-label divergence and do not claim the common-weight mixture inequality closes the history bound.
